convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'i-CAi_StDev' which is an external custom indicator, plus external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Signal modes include complex point-based and direct line comparison logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timing

long.left: BuyPosOpen=POINT: buffer[3] or buffer[5] != EMPTY_VALUE on SignalBar

short.left: SellPosOpen=POINT: buffer[2] or buffer[4] != EMPTY_VALUE on SignalBar

other_exits: BuyPosClose=POINT: sell signal dots on buffer[2] or buffer[4] close buy; BuyPosClose=DIRECT: buffer[0] rising (Line[0]>Line[1]) closes buy; SellPosClose=POINT: buy signal dots on buffer[3] or buffer[5] close sell; SellPosClose=DIRECT: buffer[0] falling (Line[0]<Line[1]) closes sell

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses

custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit signals have 3 modes each: POINT (signal dots from indicator buffers), DIRECT (line direction comparison), and WITHOUT (disabled). Buy open POINT checks buffers 3 and 5; sell open POINT checks buffers 2 and 4. Buy close POINT uses sell signal buffers (2,4); sell close POINT uses buy signal buffers (3,5). DIRECT buy open: line turns up (val[0]>val[1] && val[1]<val[2] - bottom formation). DIRECT sell open: line turns down (val[0]<val[1] && val[1]>val[2] - top formation). DIRECT buy close: line rising (val[0]>val[1]). DIRECT sell close: line falling (val[0]<val[1]). SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is evaluated, enabling use of confirmed bars. Recount mechanism re-evaluates signals on data errors or when SignalBar==0 (intrabar). GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit. LoadHistory ensures bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator i-CAi_StDev must be reimplemented in Python - it uses CXMA smoothing with configurable method (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) plus standard deviation bands with multipliers dK1 and dK2. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library contains 10+ smoothing algorithms that all need porting. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with 5 margin mode variants, position checking, and order execution - this must be reimplemented. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous closed bar (common pattern). The 6 indicator buffers map to: buffer[0]=main line, buffer[2]=sell dots, buffer[3]=buy dots, buffer[4]=sell dots (alt), buffer[5]=buy dots (alt). Point values for SL/TP (1000/2000) are in points not pips - for 5-digit EURUSD that's 100 and 200 pips respectively; no digit adjustment code exists in the EA itself so the values are raw points.
